comment: Generated by generate.py from inputs.py. Do not hand-edit.

sine_10hz_unit.description: 10 Hz sine, unit amplitude, 1024 samples at 256 Hz. RMS = 1/sqrt(2).

dc_offset.description: Constant 0.5 for 512 samples. RMS = 0.5 exactly; zero-variance edge case.

white_noise_unit.description: Gaussian white noise, sigma = 1, 2048 samples, seed 20260828.

two_tone_offset.description: 0.5 + sin(2*pi*8t) + 0.3*sin(2*pi*40t), 1500 samples at 500 Hz. No closed form; pure golden master.

stereo_tones.description: Two channels: 5 Hz unit sine and 12 Hz half-amplitude sine, 800 samples at 200 Hz. Exercises the multi-channel path.

sine_8hz_bin_centred.description: 8 Hz sine, amplitude 2.0, 256 samples at 256 Hz: exactly on an FFT bin with no zero padding, so an amplitude spectrum must read 2.0.

eeg_muse_4s.description: Synthetic 4-channel scalp EEG at Muse's 256 Hz, 4 s: pink (1/f) background (10 uV sd) plus a 10 Hz alpha rhythm of differing strength per channel, in microvolts.

eeg_openbci_2s.description: Synthetic single-channel EEG at OpenBCI's 250 Hz, 2 s = 500 samples (not a power of two, so the spectrum is zero-padded to 512).

eeg_dc_drift_30s.description: 30 s of synthetic EEG at 256 Hz riding on a 5000 uV electrode offset with a slow 40 uV drift -- the input a 0.5 Hz high-pass exists to clean up, and a stress test for float32 recursion.

ppg_muse_60bpm.description: Synthetic PPG at Muse's 64 Hz, 30 s, 60 bpm, mild RSA, wander and noise.

ppg_muse_75bpm_offset.description: Synthetic PPG at 64 Hz, 30 s, 75 bpm, on a raw-sensor-like 1.2e5 offset with stronger baseline wander.

ppg_muse_110bpm_noisy.description: Synthetic PPG at 64 Hz, 30 s, 110 bpm, heavy white noise (sd 0.12 of pulse height).

rppg_camera_72bpm.description: Synthetic camera rPPG (green-channel mean) at 30 fps, 20 s, 72 bpm: tiny pulse under large lighting drift and sensor noise.

corr_a.description: Stream A for correlation: 2 channels, 512 samples, sharing a latent with corr_b.

corr_b.description: Stream B: same latent as corr_a plus independent noise and per-channel offsets.

corr_b_short.description: The newest 400 samples of corr_b: a shorter window ending at the same instant. Paired with corr_a_head_shift it makes the two windows differ in length.

corr_a_head_shift.description: corr_a with +5 added to samples 0-111 (outside the newest 400-sample overlap).

aes17_full_scale_997hz.description: AES17 reference tone: 997 Hz sine at digital full scale (peak 1.0), 4800 samples at 48 kHz. AES17 defines its RMS level as 0 dBFS.
